g.text: NixCFG Homelab • Physical & Logical Network Architecture
Multi-Gigabit Perimeter Router (michael), 802.1Q 2.5GbE Switching, WiFi 7 AP, VLAN Segmentation, & Tailscale Overlay
Public IPv4 Dynamic DHCP • High-Speed Fiber
HP Slim Desktop S01 • Intel Core i3-12100 (4C/8T) • 16GB DDR4 • NixOS Impermanence
Exit Node: michael routes full outbound traffic
TCP MSS Clamped: 1220 bytes (prevents MTU drops)
Fleet Nodes: michael, zita, francis, jerome, agnes
KeepLINK KP-9000-9XHPML-X • 8-Port 2.5GbE PoE+ & 1-Port 10G SFP+ Smart Managed Switch
IP: 192.168.1.2 • Subnet: 255.255.255.0 • Gateway: 192.168.1.1 • Automated via 'netprov switch apply'
Tri-Band WiFi 7 AP • PoE+ Powered (Switch P2)
Hardware PVID: 62 (Skynet Guest Network) • Direct Bridged
Security: WPA3-SAE / WPA2-PSK • No Client Isolation
Security: WPA3-SAE / WPA2-PSK • Client Isolation: Active
Subnet: 192.168.77.0/24 • Gateway: 192.168.77.1 • Full LAN & WAN Access
zita • HP z620 Workstation (Storage & Homelab Server)
IP: 192.168.77.20 • Switch Port 3 (2.5GbE) • Dual Xeon E5-2667v2 (32T) • 128GB ECC
Storage: 24TB Seagate HDD + Btrfs RAID-1 SSD Cache (MergerFS Tiered Pool)
francis • HP ProDesk 600 G4 Mini (Primary Desktop)
Switch Port 4 (2.5GbE) • Intel i5-8500T (6C/6T) • 32GB RAM • 1TB NVMe
Gifted by LINUX Unplugged Listener • KDE Plasma • Agenix • Distributed Builds Client
• Access via SSID 'skynet' or AP LAN 2 Port
• Allowed: Outbound WAN NAT + mDNS/Casting to IoT
• Smart TVs, Media Streamers, Thermostats, Cameras
• Quarantined: Zero access to router management or LAN
• WAN Egress forced through PIA VPN WireGuard Gateway
• Pi-hole IoT Group: Telemetry & beacon domain blocking
• Avahi mDNS reflection allows Skylab to cast media
